g.font-family: Fira Code, Consolas, Menlo, DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace
g.text: STACK : Spring Boot, Spring Security, React.js, MongoDB Atlas
DEPLOY : React on Vercel | Spring Boot on Render | MongoDB Atlas
> Full-stack expense tracking app with 9 REST controllers covering
authentication, transactions, budgets, categories and analytics.
> Spring Security with JWT authentication and refresh-token rotation,
plus an OTP-based password-reset flow through a dedicated email service.
> Spring Scheduler job that alerts users approaching budget thresholds.
> Server-side aggregation endpoints for monthly spending trends
